title: Crispy Chilaquiles Stir Fry
description: A unique fusion of Chinese and Mexican flavors, this crispy chilaquiles stir fry is a tasty and crunchy snack or appetizer.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the torn chilaquiles and cook for another 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and stir to combine. Cook for an additional minute.
Transfer the mixture to a serving platter or individual plates.
Drizzle with the remaining 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and garnish with crispy tortilla strips.
Optional: Add some scrambled eggs on top of the stir fry for added protein and richness.
